records.part: Audiovisual equipment for Board Chambers AV rack replacement/upgrade
records.reason: PCD is Crestron-certified and is an authorized dealer for much of the equipment currently used within the Board Chambers, allowing the vendor to provide both the specialized programming services and manufacturer-supported hardware necessary for the project.

records.part: One-year support for programming, integration, and commissioning of Crestron-based AV system
records.reason: PCD is the only local certified vendor identified by the County who can program, support, and commission the County's existing Crestron-based AV systems.
